abstractFills.basis: 1.21.7's behaviour (abstract, no default): 1.21.7's Fabric API had no payload splitting, so a 1.21.7 registry registers the type with vanilla's size limit; the size is validated as Fabric's registerLarge does

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/networking/v1/Pa.basis: 1.21.7's PayloadTypeRegistry had register alone (a functional interface); 1.21.8 added an abstract registerLarge, which the adapted registry answers as above

ledger.net/fabricmc/fabric/api/biome/v1/BiomeMo: not bridgeable: 1.21.8 added an abstract view of a spawn group's weighted entries (List<Weighted<SpawnEntry>>); a 1.21.7 SpawnSettingsContext exposes its spawns only to removeSpawns' (group, entry) predicate, and SpawnEntry carries no weight (EntityType, min and max group size; the weight lives in Weighted since 1.21.5), so the weights the view must answer are nowhere a 1.21.7 context gives them
